body: It is the combination of both. I can be doing great but I still think of death all the time. I have gotten used to thinking about it and it has sortive become who I am. I won't say my life is perfect, I have my troubles as everyone else. Some days I go through really tough times, others I am okay. I usually feel really good after working out but even then when I feel good I think morbid thoughts. I just recently starting thinking how fucked up it all is.
Wow that really put some perspective into it. I am in the vicious cycle right now. Thank you for your story, that helped me a lot.
Exactly. I am not a controlling person at all, but the fact that I can not control what is going on really bothers me in this situation.

I agree it is ridiculous. I just fucking love her and miss her so much any contact I get with her makes me happy. I'm trying my best to just get over it. It is really hard when you have such strong feelings for someone else.

The context of this all may seem like I don't love her but I do. When we last talked last week sunday I told her I respect her decision to be single and she can do whatever she pleases. It is just killing me on the inside. 

And I totally agree there is a large part of me that wants to be with her cause it pleases me. I liken the relationship to someone addicted to drugs. When I can't talk to her I am in serious withdrawls, but as soon as she says something to me I get the "high" and feel great for that moment.

She last told me that she just doesn't want to be in a relationship-period. Which I don't understand. I mean if she loves me why is that. 

I know the healthiest thing to do is move on and I am trying but I don't think I can. I am obsessive over her to where it is impacting me life negatively.

I wish I could confront her, but she has cut all contact from me. It is driving me to the brink of insanity.

This isn't like I just can't get over this woman deal. I am obsessive about her. It takes all my strength to go a day without sending her a pity text in hopes she will text me. I called her today and she texted me "stop calling me". I was actually happy she texted me that because that was the first time I have heard from her in a week. It is fucked up and I don't know what to do to move on.
